text: dsh-wellness 是一个面向 DSH web 客户端的健康提醒插件，通过 Cordis 注册后台控制器，定时观察根 agent 的运行状态，并把到期提醒作为普通会话消息发送给空闲 agent。它可以按设定时间提醒早餐、午餐、晚餐和睡眠，也会累计 DSH agent 活跃工作时间并在达到阈值后提醒休息；提醒会排队等待空闲会话，不打断正在运行的 agent。适合希望在 DSH 工作期间获得规律作息提示的用户。默认启用，时刻与间隔可配置；代码未显示需要 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-wellness adds meal, sleep, and break reminders to DSH web sessions. A timed Cordis controller queues due prompts as ordinary messages for an idle agent, without interrupting a running turn. Times and intervals are configurable; code shows no API key or external service.
想在 DSH 里按时收到吃饭和睡觉的提醒。
让 DSH 连续工作一段时间后提醒我起来休息。
Remind me to take a break after I've been actively using DSH for a while.
dsh-wellness 的功能「用餐与睡眠提醒」：按配置的每日时间检查早餐、午餐、晚餐和睡眠提醒窗口，每种提醒每天最多触发一次。到期后会作为会话消息排队，并在有空闲根 agent 时投递。
dsh-wellness 的功能「活跃工作休息提醒」：根据根 agent 的运行状态累计活跃时间；达到配置阈值且冷却时间已过时，生成休息提示。提示等待空闲根 agent 接收，不会插入正在运行的会话轮次。

dsh-wellness README · dsh-wellness：Health reminders for DeepSeek Harness: tell you when it is time to eat and
sleep, and nudge you to get up and move after two hours of active work. The
plugin watches the dsh sessions on your machine and, when a reminder is due,
has a live agent remind you as an ordinary in-conversation message.

dsh-wellness README · What it does：- **Meal & sleep reminders** — default routine breakfast 08:00, lunch 12:00,
  dinner 18:00, sleep 23:00. Each is configurable (`HH:MM`), can be disabled,
  fires at most once per day within a window around its target, and never
  interrupts a running agent turn.
- **Active-work break reminder** — while any dsh session has a running agent,
  the plugin accumulates your active work time. After the configured active
  span (default 120 minutes) it asks a live agent to tell you to take a break.
  A cooldown (default 20 minutes) prevents nagging.

dsh-wellness README · Install：Install it into your `web` profile, then restart `dsh web`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <PACKAGE-NAME>
```

It can also be installed from the Plugin Market once this package is listed.

dsh-wellness README · Configure：Open your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (or the market's plugin configuration)
and override the plugin row:

```yaml
- id: wellness
  name: <PACKAGE-NAME>
  config:
    mealTimes:

`mealTimes` fields and `sleepTime` use 24-hour `HH:MM`; `null` or `''` disables
that slot. `enabled: false` keeps the plugin mounted but inert. The optional
`copy` map overrides the wording of each reminder kind.

dsh-wellness README · Limitations：- Delivery needs a live idle session: there is no push or OS notification. If
  the app is closed or every session is busy, the reminder waits until an idle
  agent is available.
- "Working" means a dsh session currently has a running agent (plus a short
  idle grace). Time spent outside dsh is not counted.
- Progress is held in memory and resets on restart.
